notes: LONGITUDE — a single-file documentary atlas on standard time. Five interactive components: scrubbable timeline, time-zone explorer, solar-time calculator with analemma, filterable observatory index, and a 6-question teaching quiz, plus glossary. Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, no dependencies; procedural SVG diagrams and canvas starfield. Factual spine cited; illustrations labelled as computed/schematic; invented phrasing flagged. Browser-tested via localhost: page loads with 0 console errors; timeline keyboard/click, city explorer, calculator (Feb -15, Nov +16), observatory filters and quiz scoring exercised via in-page evaluation; no horizontal overflow at tested width; screenshot capture unavailable in this environment, so visual review was via preview and accessibility tree, not pixel screenshots. No network requests; localStorage access guarded with try/catch.
